name: MOTS-c
aka: mitochondrial ORF of the 12S rRNA type-c

typical_dose_shape.note: No FDA-approved dosing reference exists for this compound. This range describes reported use and is not a recommendation.

description: A 16-amino-acid peptide encoded in the mitochondrial 12S rRNA gene, described in preclinical work as a regulator of metabolic homeostasis through AMPK. It has no FDA-approved product and no human trial safety record. No FDA label exists. No completed human safety trials.

systems.note: Taken for metabolic and exercise-capacity effect via AMPK; the intended effect, evidenced preclinically.
Claimed insulin-sensitising effect is uncharacterised in humans and could move glycaemia unpredictably.
No human safety data and no product-quality control.

monitors.why: Claimed insulin-sensitising effect with no human dosing reference.
